name: subterra
description: Geospatial land, mineral, and oil/gas opportunity aggregation platform

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:install && cd apps/desktop && npm run start
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:pack:win
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run desktop:install && cd apps/desktop && npm run build:win
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: npm run desktop:install && cd apps/desktop && npm run build:mac
scripts.desktop:pack:linux: npm run desktop:install && cd apps/desktop && npm run build:linux
scripts.start: npm run infra:up && npm run setup && npm run dev
